task2_bh_and_gate.family_definition:
Task 2: BH counts from the engine's p values with an independently written family definition, and the gate
recall from the frozen inputs of results/gates/G_pc_attempt1.json.

Family F1 (design 5.6, test_families_s5.F1_S1_main): every (g, d) in U (g eligible; d in D_g minus self-null) whose
d is not g's own EXPDOSE, with a finite p (tests the engine dropped for < 5 carriers or zero residual variance have no
p and are not tests). F2 = the own-EXPDOSE tests. BH (step-up) at q = s1_s5.bh_q over the whole family.

readings_R0: 5.3 screen days: one droppable covariate = cached screen_days_dev_humagne ('screen days within Humagne'); pipeline_params lists screen_days as droppable, DESIGN lists it both in the library block and as droppable
5.3 S1 design has no METH_absent / MSI_unknown (1.6: S1 drops NA lines per feature); own CN NaN -> 0 with CN_absent

5.3 'Leverages depend on (NaN group, d) only': read as a computational remark; my h_ii uses the full Z (incl. own CN, EXPGATE). Engine p agree to 1e-13, so the engine also uses the exact full-model hat
5.3 df 'n - rank(Z) - 2': rank(Z) counts the intercept; binary d min(., carrier clusters - 1) (A7 iv)

5.6 F1: BH over all U tests except own EXPDOSE incl. collinear_with_design tests; list hits exclude collinear_with_design (5.3 'never counted as determinants'); same rule for F2, S1-pred, MD-strict, MD-global
4.1 'NA -> 0' after standardisation once on D (mean/SD ddof 0 over non-NaN D values)
4.1 FWL block = the 4.1 list only (no screen days, no droppable covariates); 5.3 < 2-line level merge applied

4.1 SIS: top-300 |corr| union forced (gene-specific relations except self-null); 25-alpha grid from the full-D screened set; 1-SE with SD(fold MSE, ddof 1)/sqrt(5); stage X CV on each fold's own stage-G residual
13.3 'beta within 1e-3 relative': which beta is unstated; pass/fail uses mean beta over 50 subsamples (the EN rank statistic, engine column 'beta'); full-D beta reported alongside

5.5 library block also removes screen days (5.3 puts them in the library block); burden = MSI + DMG_BURDEN; primary-disease sensitivity = block added to the full model, same flag rule (5.5 does not restate it)

notes.task3_diagnosis: after fix 4: lambda_G/X agree to 4e-7, full-D beta to 4e-5 for all 30 selected features, frequency max |diff| 0.02 (one subsample fit in 3 features of genes 5045/6927), selected sets identical. The only out-of-tolerance item is mean beta of 5045 x SIL-METH:604 (rel 1.25e-3 vs 1e-3): its full-D beta agrees to 6e-10, so the gap comes from the same 5045 subsample fit(s) whose active set differs (AMP:6427 0.08 vs 0.06, AMP:9123 0.10 vs 0.12) - a solver-tolerance (tol 1e-3) / SIS-boundary effect in one half-sample, not a rule difference. Strictly a FAIL of the beta tolerance; PASS if 'beta' means full-D beta.
